MatterTitle: An ordinance relating to contracting indebtedness; authorizing and providing for the issuance and sale of limited tax general obligation bonds to pay or reimburse all or a portion of the costs of various elements of the City’s capital improvement program and for other City purposes approved by ordinance and to pay the costs of issuance of the bonds; providing parameters for the bond sale terms including conditions, covenants, and other sale terms; creating the 2027 Multipurpose LTGO Bond Fund; amending Ordinance 125197, as previously amended by Ordinances 125456, 125715, 125986, and 127344; Ordinance 125456, as previously amended by Ordinance 126938; Ordinance 125715, as previously amended by Ordinance 126938; Ordinance 125986; Ordinance 126219, as previously amended by Ordinances 126288, 126479, 126938, and 127146; Ordinance 126479, as previously amended by Ordinance 127146; Ordinance 126714; Ordinance 126938; and Ordinance 127146; and ratifying and confirming certain prior acts.
